* feat(results): ask before a revision sets hand-placed pieces aside (purses-w7ss.5)

Supersede now refuses with 409 revision_discards_pins + pinCount when the
open draft holds pins the revision would move or drop, unless the request
says { discardPins: true }. The check runs under the curator lock before any
write and returns a sentinel (no throw inside the transaction, so a prompt
never logs as a DB error). MakeRevisionButton shows an inline note on that
409 with "Start the revision" / "Keep my ranking" and a quiet link to the
ranking; focus moves to the note and back to the trigger on close/failure.

* fix(migrate): refuse a mismatched non-pooling URL; drop the session SET fallback

pickMigrationUrl now parses both URLs and only switches to
POSTGRES_URL_NON_POOLING when it names the same Neon endpoint, database
and user as the pooler DATABASE_URL; any mismatch or unparseable URL
throws (messages name the mismatched part, never a URL). migrate.ts logs
the hostname only. ensureLockTimeout no longer issues a session SET —
not applied means wrong URL, and it refuses.

saved rows' usage (the DB tier covers draft/revision, not saveAndShare);
corrected the comment that over-claimed it. generateOrderedIdFactory's
comment no longer says base ulid is non-monotonic (consolidation is
purses-w7ss.20). decision-log test drops the never-called stub.

for the ghost hover state, the now-unused primary-hover-on-content-soft
pair dropped.

* fix(migrate): derive the direct Neon host from a pooled DATABASE_URL; lock_timeout needs the direct endpoint

Neon's pooler silently drops lock_timeout as a startup parameter, and on
Preview POSTGRES_URL_NON_POOLING points at a different endpoint, so the
build failed. For a -pooler DATABASE_URL the migrator now uses a matching
POSTGRES_URL_NON_POOLING, else derives the direct host by dropping -pooler
(warning when a supplied var was ignored). ensureLockTimeout stays the backstop.
